hypothesis: One exact solid LZMA stream plus a fixed split reconstructs the ELI executable and dictionary while reducing complete stored-program bytes and preserving the B2 archive.
interfaces_exposed: One LZMA payload; fixed executable split offset; identical cmix and dictionary bytes
kill_condition: Reject if complete package is not smaller by at least one byte or if any payload, archive, roundtrip, determinism, or guard differs.
promotion_condition: Complete program package is smaller than the ELI parent, split payloads are byte-identical, and exact 250K archive, roundtrip, determinism, and memory match B2.
title: Solid LZMA package for stripped B2 executable and dictionary
